OhGeesy, whose real name is Alejandro Carranza, is a 32-year-old rapper, songwriter, and entrepreneur from Los Angeles, California. He is best known as one of the founding members of the legendary West Coast rap group Shoreline Mafia, alongside Fenix Flexin, Rob Vicious, and Master Kato. OhGeesy rose to fame in 2017 with Shoreline Mafia’s breakout project ShorelineDoThatShit, which featured hits like “Musty,” “Bottle Service,” and “Nun Major.” His signature flow, catchy hooks, and undeniable West Coast sound helped turn Shoreline Mafia into one of California’s biggest rap movements. Following the group’s initial split, OhGeesy established a successful solo career with projects like Geezyworld, Geezyworld 2, and Paid N Full, along with popular records such as “GEEKALEEK.” In recent years, he has reunited with Fenix Flexin, released new music, and continued performing at major festivals, arenas, and nightclubs across the country. From Los Angeles to Las Vegas, OhGeesy continues to represent West Coast hip-hop while expanding his legacy as both a solo artist and a member of Shoreline Mafia.

Mike Sherm, whose real name is Michael Sherman, is a 30-year-old rapper and songwriter from Antioch, California, who has become one of the most recognizable artists in the Bay Area’s underground hip-hop scene. Known for his distinctive delivery, confident lyrics, catchy punchlines, and energetic West Coast production, Mike Sherm built a loyal following through SoundCloud and YouTube before gaining widespread recognition throughout California. He made a name for himself with popular tracks such as “Cookies,” “Bands On Me,” “A-Hole,” “Gimme That,” and “Hotboy,” earning millions of streams and developing a strong fan base. His music has become a staple of the Northern California rap scene, with his influence extending throughout the West Coast. Despite maintaining a relatively private personal life, Mike Sherm has continued building his career through independent releases, collaborations, and live performances.
